items.headline: Clippers Hit with Severe Penalties in Salary Cap Scandal
items.summary: The NBA announced a hefty punishment for the Los Angeles Clippers' salary cap scandal on September 2, stripping them of five first-round picks from 2029 to 2033, imposing a $30 million fine, and suspending owner Steve Ballmer for one year from league and team activities.

items.headline: Nike Unveils New 'Specter' Edition Uniforms for Eight NBA Franchises
items.summary: Nike and the NBA officially revealed the new 'Specter' Edition uniforms on September 10, 2026, for eight of the league's oldest teams, including the Celtics, Knicks, and Lakers. These jerseys merge team history and city heritage with modern designs, with their retail release and on-court debut set for later in Fall 2026.

items.headline: Kawhi Leonard Trade Door Opens Amid DOJ Investigation
items.summary: The NBA's investigation into Kawhi Leonard has concluded, potentially paving the way for a trade to the Toronto Raptors. However, the Department of Justice has reportedly launched a criminal investigation into the Clippers' dealings with Leonard, adding a new layer to the situation.

items.headline: Ben Simmons Signs with Sacramento Kings, Addresses Critics
items.summary: Veteran guard Ben Simmons, 30, has officially returned to the NBA, signing a deal with the Sacramento Kings. Simmons has already responded to an unnamed NBA veteran who accused him of 'quitting' on the game.

items.headline: Jalen Duren and Pistons Remain Far Apart in Contract Talks
items.summary: All-NBA big man Jalen Duren and the Detroit Pistons are at a standstill in contract negotiations. Duren, 22, is reportedly seeking a deal worth at least $40 million annually, while the Pistons' latest offer is around five years and $190 million.

items.headline: Domantas Sabonis Trade Still Possible, Kings' Price a Hurdle
items.summary: Trade discussions involving Domantas Sabonis continue, but the Sacramento Kings' asking price for the All-Star center remains a potential sticking point. Both Toronto and Charlotte have reportedly engaged in discussions with the Kings in the past.

items.headline: Hawks Waive Devin Carter; Celtics Reportedly Interested
items.summary: Providence College standout Devin Carter was reportedly waived by the Atlanta Hawks on Friday. The Boston Celtics are among the teams showing interest in Carter if he clears waivers and becomes a free agent.

items.headline: Lonnie Walker IV Joins Nuggets on Training Camp Deal
items.summary: Seven-year NBA veteran Lonnie Walker IV officially signed a non-guaranteed training camp deal with the Denver Nuggets on September 10, aiming to secure a roster spot for the upcoming season.

items.headline: Phoenix Suns' Big Man Mark Williams Out for Several Months
items.summary: The Phoenix Suns have suffered a significant blow before the start of the season, as their big man, Mark Williams, is expected to miss several months after undergoing surgery to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder.

items.headline: Draymond Green Explains Equal NBA Jersey Sales Payouts
items.summary: Draymond Green clarified that NBA stars like Stephen Curry receive the same licensing check from jersey sales and other group licensing agreements as end-of-the-bench players. He noted that eligible players get an even split from the licensing pool, with rookies receiving their check from the previous year's revenue.

items.headline: NBA 2026-27 Season Nears: Key Dates Announced
items.summary: The NBA's 2026-27 regular season is scheduled to tip off on October 20, 2026. Prior to that, training camps for teams participating in international preseason games will open on September 22, with the rest of the league starting camps on September 29, and preseason games officially beginning on October 3.
